programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u035/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The horizontal color-2 bar divides the upper pattern from the lower one.
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row))
    top = grid[0]
    bottom = grid[-1]
    shared = {c for c in range(w) if top[c] != 0 and top[c] == bottom[c]}
    for c in shared:
        for r in range(1, divider):
            if out[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = 4
    return out
'''
